title: Qualify chemical commitment before stable error; distinguish bond identity from unjoined-donor clearance

scientific_scope_status: Postbond rejection can improve conditional purity without restoring original-root yield: with correct/wrong irreversible attempt probabilities p,w and ideal readers, correct L-step yield is at most[p/(p+w)]^L. Endless iid false reads of a persistent wrong product eventually admit it. Complete donor-owned reset and no premature chemistry give precommit wrong/correct odds (lambda_W/lambda_C)*[(k+u_C)/(k+u_W)]^n; any fixed premature-coupling hazard changes the large-n limit. Any receipt test has alpha-beta<=TV(P_C,P_W) for its actual observation laws. Clearance of unjoined donors and preservation of registered roots obey a separate wash-time feasibility bound; it does not distinguish stable wrong covalent bonds. Two99% factors multiply to98.01%, not99%, under the declared product model.
